implementation: Coda corrected derivative of frozen Grok Build script; original is separate
execution_note: computed_* fields are filled by running this script

units.oxygen_content: mol/m^3 total oxygen per liquid volume, declared

identities.global_necessary_condition: Q * C_in >= M, and alpha_max * Q * C_in >= M

nameplate_conditional.slpm_note: SLPM is a gas-metrology unit. Reading 40 SLPM as 40 actual liquid L/min is an extra assumption.
nameplate_conditional.hydraulic_power_uses: actual volumetric flow, P_hyd = delta_p * Q_actual

interpretation_gas_SLPM.reason: Standard gas flow equals actual volume flow only at the meter standard state. delta_p * Q_standard is not hydraulic power.

nameplate_conditional.rating_product_note: Nameplate max pressure and nameplate max flow are separate ratings. On a falling pump curve their product exceeds delta_p * Q at a real point.

cornell_2019_soft_fish.relevance_to_this_screen: Electrochemical storage plus hydraulic actuation. It supplies no parameter for this perfusion screen.

limitations: Steady incompressible flow, constant eta, linear resistance or fixed delta_p.
Oxygen balance is one pass of total content C. A recycle loop needs an explicit oxygenator balance before another pass is credited.
Segment deliveries and the end-to-end drop are the same oxygen and are stored once.
Local ceilings and flow fractions are independent assumed numbers.
The survival flag is the inequality boolean only.
Nameplate 500 W, 40 SLPM and 100 psi are unverified claims, not a simultaneous point, and do not set R, eta, or demand.
Heat from pump losses is not coupled into the module.
No solubility, binding curve, metabolism data set, culture method, or clinical target is used.
